user_goal.text: Identify the most followed artist the user follows on Spotify.

benchmark_success.rationale: TestTracker succeeds exactly when every registered test passes.

checked_by.text: The official TestTracker evaluation of the answer comparison and model-change check.

decisive_artifacts.artifact: Retained submitted answer and official evaluator comparison result
decisive_artifacts.question: Does the retained evaluator result show that the registered answer-comparison test passed?

decisive_artifacts.artifact: Retained start/end database diff and official evaluator result
decisive_artifacts.question: Does the retained evaluator result show that the registered no-model-changes test passed?

success_if.text: [appworld_test_001_844d21b309f0] passes exactly when this official requirement is satisfied: assert answers match.
success_if.rationale: The first registered test compares the submitted answer with the official answer using TestTracker.answer.

success_if.text: [appworld_test_002_818d3311397a] passes exactly when this official requirement is satisfied: assert no model changes.
success_if.rationale: The second registered test requires changed_model_names() to be falsy.

fail_if.text: [appworld_test_001_844d21b309f0] fails exactly when this official requirement is not satisfied: assert answers match.
fail_if.rationale: A failed official answer comparison is a failed registered test.

fail_if.text: [appworld_test_002_818d3311397a] fails exactly when this official requirement is not satisfied: assert no model changes.
fail_if.rationale: Any model change makes the registered falsy check fail.

undecided_if.text: Undecided only if retained evidence cannot determine one or more frozen registered-test outcomes.
undecided_if.rationale: A registered-test outcome must not be inferred when its decisive retained evidence is missing or non-decisive.
